title: CordHistoryView
description: Response of GET /ui/crew/{astronaut_id}/views/cord-history: the most recent cord-resistance measurements of each posture (back straight, maximum flexion), valid and invalid, newest first. Bounded: at most `limit` per posture, never the whole history. A measurement is valid only if its session completed and the feature has a positive value and quality at or above the configured minimum score; an invalid one says why. Only measurements: a calculated length estimate is never stored nor listed here.

limit.description: Maximum number of measurements listed per posture.

resistance_ohm.description: Resistance reported by the session; null when the session produced none.

quality_score.description: Quality score of the resistance feature, 0 to 1; null when the session produced no such feature.

invalid_reason.description: Why the measurement is not valid; null when it is. CORD_INVALID_NOT_COMPLETED: the session did not complete. CORD_INVALID_NO_VALUE: no positive resistance was obtained. CORD_INVALID_LOW_QUALITY: the quality score is below the configured minimum.
